description: Lunar 1.5 e-commerce on top of laravel/base + laravel/inertia-vue (Inertia storefront). Lunar 1.x stable pulls Filament 4 and owns its own admin panel (registered at /admin in AppServiceProvider through LunarPanel), so this variant does NOT include laravel/filament; Filament 5 and Lunar 1.x cannot be installed together. Overwrites app/Domain/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php and app/Infrastructure/Models/User.php (LunarUser). After creating the app: `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan lunar:install` (default language, currency, channel, tax class and the first admin). Lunar config is not published; run `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=lunar` when it needs changing.
